# End-user accounting checks — October 10, 2026 r2

This is a concrete test plan for an agent to execute as an ordinary user. It does not require the owner to calculate entries or operate approval workflows. No flow below has been executed by this document's author; expected figures are proposed synthetic inputs, not results or installed fixtures. Record the actual UI outcome, exact source/build identity, screenshot and resulting document/report identities for each executed step. A blocked prerequisite is a blocked test, never a pass.

## What the ordinary Preview can do

`apps/jentra_desktop/lib/main.dart` supplies null operational gateways when Supabase is unconfigured. The Preview foundation supplies `preview-actor`, Jentra Holdings, a legal entity and branches. `businessCapabilitiesProvider` supplies setup view/manage permissions and quotation view for navigation; it does not grant finance, receipt, invoice posting or procurement authority. Every accounting controller requires a real gateway and the appropriate current scope/capabilities. `/finance` itself is a module placeholder; the real finance routes are listed below.

The Preview is useful for shell navigation, setup forms and component demonstrations. It cannot post an invoice, receipt, bill, payment or journal or generate authoritative statements. Golden/widget tests instantiate fake gateways and in-memory databases themselves; those are not available as a normal Preview session. The self-contained owner image gallery is an image review, not an interactive accounting application.

Business setup has fixed demonstration records dated September 1. For example, it lists LKR/USD/EUR/SAR, a sample USD/LKR rate and VAT18. A preview save updates the controller's in-memory list and deletes the associated draft; a later refresh rebuilds the fixed preview records. Do not assume that a saved preview setup record will survive refresh or feed another module. Theme/density preferences have separate local persistence. Local encrypted draft code uses native SQLite and application support/secure storage; no browser persistence/build compatibility has been verified. Do not open or copy any acceptance store to discover whether it works.

| Preview user action | Expected observable outcome | What this proves |
|---|---|---|
| Open the fresh isolated Preview, select entity and branch, then open Business setup | Scope controls and fixed setup records load; no connected business account is implied | Ordinary shell/setup availability on that exact build |
| Open a setup form and leave a required code/name empty, then validate/save | Named validation prevents a valid save and preserves entered fields | Form validation only |
| Enter a unique clearly synthetic setup name, save, then refresh the list | Save reports “Saved in development preview”; compare the refreshed list with the original fixed fixtures rather than assuming durable business data | Preview memory/persistence limitation, not installed setup |
| Open `/finance`, `/finance/journals`, `/finance/statements`, `/receivables` | Finance landing is a placeholder; controller-based screens provide scope/permission/connection guidance and do not enable posting | Fail-closed presentation; not a transaction test |
| Use the normal navigation and command palette with keyboard and 200% text | Record actual focus, selection, escape/back and visible controls without assuming widget tests certify native input | Fresh native usability when actually executed |

The current null-controller journal/statement messages focus on permission/scope even when no gateway is configured. Record this as a usability finding if the observed Preview leaves an ordinary user unable to distinguish a missing connection from missing permission. Do not weaken permission guards to make the screen appear functional.

## Prerequisites for real accounting flows

Use a separate reviewed synthetic test workspace and a fresh isolated Connected identity. The confirmed trial account `desktop-test-20261009@jentra.invalid` has zero memberships; successful sign-in alone cannot execute these flows. Private credentials and genuine MFA stay with the owner/private Auth Admin context. Do not reuse another chat's session or fabricate claims. Additional provider dependencies and runtime setup remain unapproved, so the current plan must not create the fixture or attempt server mutations.

Before execution, prove the selected tenant/entity/branch is exclusively authorized for the test and contains no unrelated opening balances or postings. Configure LKR as transaction/base currency, explicit synthetic exclusive 18% input/output tax, active source/account mappings, matching sequences, an open period and a real customer/supplier/cash-bank account. The rate is a deliberately configured test input, not a statutory tax assertion. Use non-stock service lines to isolate accounting from valuation. Preparation, independent approval and posting use distinct authorized identities as required by each workflow; the same user must fail self-approval. Record account codes from the actual named pickers instead of guessing identifiers.

Choose an actual open test date on or before the report cutoff. Record it once and keep invoice, credit, receipt, allocations, bill and payment within the same selected period; due dates are explicit. Any configured workflow, missing provider, membership, permission or period blocker stops the dependent flow and receives a precise result.

## One exact base-currency scenario

The following expected balances assume zero opening balances, no other postings, no discounts, no FX, no write-off and no inventory effects. They are a hand-calculated oracle to compare with server-recalculated saved documents and posted evidence.

| Step and normal user flow | Exact inputs | Expected accounting and user-visible result |
|---|---|---|
| **A1 — Sales invoice:** Fulfillment & receivables → Invoices → New; choose customer and service, save, submit, independently approve if required, then post | 5 units × LKR 200.000000; exclusive output tax 18%; no discount | Net **1000.000000**, tax **180.000000**, gross **1180.000000**. One immutable invoice and AR open item. Posted entry: AR debit 1180; revenue credit 1000; output-tax credit 180. Draft/save/approval alone creates no posted balance. |
| **A2 — Source-linked credit:** Create a credit from that invoice's service line; save/submit/approve/post through the permitted lifecycle | Credit exactly 1 of the original 5 units at the original basis | Net credit **200.000000**, tax **36.000000**, gross **236.000000**. Source original remains immutable. Revenue debit 200, output-tax debit 36, AR credit 236. If the credit requires explicit allocation, allocate its 236 to this invoice; residual after applied credit **944.000000**. Before allocation, invoice and unapplied credit remain separate open items. |
| **A3 — Customer receipt:** Select Receipts, create with the configured LKR bank, reference and date; save/submit/approve/post, then allocate to A1 | Receipt **800.000000**; allocation **800.000000** | Bank debit 800; AR credit 800. Receipt creates a separately traceable credit/open item. Base-currency allocation must reduce invoice/credit residuals exactly without a new profit/FX journal. Remaining net customer receivable **144.000000**; unapplied receipt **0.000000**. |
| **A4 — Direct service supplier bill:** Procurement supplier-bill workspace; select supplier, direct non-stock expense line and explicit input tax, save/match-review if needed/post | 3 units × LKR 100.000000, exclusive input tax 18% | Net expense **300.000000**, input-tax **54.000000**, AP **354.000000**. Expense debit 300, input-tax asset debit 54, AP credit 354. No stock movement or duplicated receipt value. |
| **A5 — Partial supplier payment:** Select A4's due open item in a payment proposal, choose bank, submit, have the separate approver decide, then record/post payment | Partial allocation/payment **200.000000**, an explicit synthetic reference | AP debit 200; bank credit 200. Remaining supplier liability **154.000000**. This is a recorded payment; no bank transfer is sent. Proposal approval alone must not post. |
| **A6 — Customer/supplier statements and control reconciliation:** Select the cutoff after all above posting/allocation dates and drill through sources | Same entity, explicit cutoff, matching currency/scope | Customer net due **144.000000**, supplier due **154.000000**. AR/AP controls agree exactly with their subledgers. Show invoice/credit/receipt/payment/allocation IDs and exact dated residuals. |
| **A7 — Financial statements:** Financial statements → Trial balance, Profit & loss and Balance sheet; generate and open the frozen report | Same active period and cutoff; no comparative initially | Closing debit balances: bank **600**, AR **144**, input-tax **54**, service expense **300**. Closing credit balances: AP **154**, output-tax **144**, revenue **800**. Debit total **1098**, credit total **1098**, difference **0**. Profit **500**. Assets **798** = liabilities **298** + current earnings **500**; balance-sheet difference **0**. Statements consolidate the entity, so unrelated branch postings invalidate this simple oracle. |

Do not infer the exact remaining invoice line quantity from the accounting residual. Credit eligibility and source quantities are separate checks. Also compare a cutoff before the receipt/payment/allocation date: later events must not silently rewrite an earlier as-of statement. Preserve the original generated report and create a new report after later/backdated postings; an immutable report must not change in place.

## Validation and recovery checks

| Test | User action | Expected result |
|---|---|---|
| Exact decimal validation | Type `0.0000001` in an amount/quantity field that accepts six places | Named precision rejection; no silent rounding or dispatch that becomes a valid posting |
| Manual journal balance | Manual journals → New journal; freight expense debit `123.456789`, accrued expense credit `123.456788` | Save/submit/post must not produce a balanced journal; exact difference `0.000001`. Correct the credit to `123.456789`: saved transaction/base totals both `123.456789`. |
| Segregation and immutability | Attempt to approve one's own submitted journal; then have the distinct authorized actors approve and post the balanced journal | Self-approval denied. Successful posted journal is immutable. One freight expense debit and accrued-liability credit `123.456789`. |
| Linked reversal | Create a reasoned linked reversal of that posted journal, separately submit/approve/post in an open period | Original remains readable, new reversal has exact opposite lines, aggregate impact of this pair is zero. A second posted reversal is rejected, while identical command replay returns the original receipt. Do not edit/delete original history. |
| Allocation limits | Attempt receipt allocation `800.000001`, or allocate a second amount after the 800 has been fully used | Exact over-allocation rejected; no changed residual or partial journal. Use actual source residuals in the confirmation. |
| Source-credit limit | Attempt to credit more than the five original service units or to credit an ineligible source | Reject excess/invalid source; original invoice remains unchanged |
| Safe local recovery | In the fresh isolated app, edit a draft, save locally, leave/reopen and restart that same isolated identity | Encrypted typed inputs recover only in their original actor/entity/branch scope. Never inspect/copy another product's store. This requires actual native restart evidence; widget fixtures alone do not pass it. |
| Uncertain server response | Under a separately reviewed bounded fault protocol, interrupt the response after command dispatch; reopen recovery and use “Retry saved command” | Same sealed command/key/body only; exactly one posted document/journal/receipt. Do not create a new command to “retry”. No fault injection into shared live state from this plan. |
| Access loss | Sign out or have an authorized independent actor revoke the test permission, while the original screen/dialog is open | Posted/register/confirmation evidence disappears. Late completions do not restore it. Inputs/sealed original requests remain recoverable under fresh permitted authorization. |
| Version conflict | Two independently authorized test sessions edit the same allowed draft, then save the stale copy | Visible conflict, preserved local inputs, explicit reload/review. This requires actual committed independent-session evidence; mocked conflict tests are separate. |
| Bank statement balance | Bank reconciliation → preview bounded CSV/XLSX with opening `0`, lines `800` and `-200`, closing `600` | Preview exact net `600`; import preserves statement lines and creates no journal. Duplicate statement/reference rejected. Exact match to the two bank journal lines creates no accounting effect. Formula cells, invalid dates and unbalanced closing reject atomically. Actual file selection/native persistence remain to be executed. |
| Report drill-through/export | Open the actual immutable A7 report, choose an account and its posted journal; request governed export, download and reopen in a separate viewer | Exact scoped source lines/totals and frozen export identity/hash match. Creation metadata or displayed CSV text alone does not prove actual download. Actual export remains a separate gated test. |

For indirect cash flow, first prove effective dated cash/working-capital mappings. Missing mapping or bridge difference must produce named blockers. Do not approve a cash-flow result solely because the simple scenario has net bank 600. Period close/reopen, foreign currency, inventory costing and tax filing are additional scenarios, not claims made by this plan.

## Execution record

At preparation: **zero accounting user flows executed here; all transaction/recovery/export outcomes pending**. Root owns computer use, fresh build/source attribution and serialized SDK jobs. Native computer tooling is available in the current session; actual app availability and execution still require fresh build/launch evidence. The previously supplied r13 Preview/Connected binaries are historical for the changed dependency lock and two test-helper files. A fresh isolated ordinary Preview can establish usability limits without live fixture creation; genuine accounting flows require separately authorized current runtime providers/configuration and private authenticated identities.

For every actual flow, save a compact record with `case`, `sourceManifest`, `packageSha256`, `mode`, `actorLabel`, `scopeLabels`, `startedAt`, `expected`, `observed`, `result` (`pass`, `fail`, `blocked`), source/document/report IDs, screenshot paths and remaining gate. Keep passwords, tokens, MFA seeds, secret values and unrelated business data out of the record.
